items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release approvals, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is unknown. Compliance is technical-only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are containment signals only. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, allow only bounded reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, and data-handling boundaries, and continue existing read-only evidence work. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence, affected scope, owners, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate requests or production work.
